deviations.description: The human identity check disconnected and reconnected F411-A before serial capture. It occurred before the assigned scientific attempt and is retained in human_wiring_confirmation.json.

Continuous capture began before flashing. While the payload was programmed first, the previously running controller retained two timeout markers before its own exact flash/reset. They precede controller READY and every precondition/scientific boundary and are excluded from trial scoring.

The original precondition JSON end-host field reflects record-write time after stabilization. precondition_boundary_correction.json provides the retained post-window host boundary without altering the original file.

Exact-byte capture retained a 19-byte prefix '[OBC] PAYLOAD_ACCE' after the final validated status and after pilot_validation finished, while ports were closing. It is outside every scored/stabilization boundary, remains byte-valid, and is not used as an accepted exchange.

unexpected_scientific_outcome.description: During the full four-second 110 ms exposure, post-restore status recorded cumulative timeout=8 and seq=8, with one explicit sequence-rejection marker and OFFLINE after the third timeout. This is preserved descriptively and was not tuned or retried.
